name: nodalmerge-studio
description: Agent-native collaborative workspace — branch visualization, merge review, and agent orchestration for NodalMerge.

nodalmerge.runtimeUri.description: Base URI of the NodalMerge Studio runtime (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5080). Empty (default) connects to a locally-managed runtime on 127.0.0.1:5080. Set this to point the extension at a standalone or remote runtime instead.

nodalmerge.hostPort.description: Port the Studio Host listens on.

nodalmerge.workspaceDataPath.description: Where Studio stores branch files, the node-store database, and blobs. Empty (default) uses VS Code's per-workspace extension storage, outside your repository. Set a relative path (e.g. ".nodalmerge") to store it inside this repo instead, or an absolute path to use a custom location.

nodalmerge.repositoryPath.description: Absolute path to the repository Studio should operate against (seed branches from, build/test/run in). Empty (default) uses the first folder open in this VS Code window. Set this to point Studio at a different checkout than the one currently open.

nodalmerge.agentProfiles.description: Named agent profiles. Each profile maps an agentType string to a display label, task domain, and optional model hint.

id.description: Agent type identifier (used as agentType when spawning).

deploymentMode.description: How this agent is deployed. 'inline' = in-process managed by the runtime (default). 'headless' = standalone peer process; vscode-lm provider is not available in this mode.

provider.description: LLM provider. vscode-lm is only valid for inline deploymentMode.

baseUrl.description: API base URL (not used for vscode-lm).

apiKeyRef.description: Secret storage key for the API key (inline agents). Headless agents manage their own credentials.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt passed to the agent when spawned. Overrides any runtime default for this domain.

tools.description: Allowlist of MCP tool names this agent may call. Empty array means all tools are permitted.

nodalmerge.topologyTemplates.description: Named topology templates defining orchestrator + worker role assignments.

orchestrator.description: Profile id for the orchestrator agent.

nodalmerge.defaultTopology.description: Name of the topology template to use when spawning a new workspace.

nodalmerge.defaultReviewPolicy.description: Default review policy applied to new work units created in the Goal Workspace.

nodalmerge.requireBuildBeforeProposal.description: Require passing build before proposal submission.

nodalmerge.requireTestBeforeProposal.description: Require passing tests before proposal submission.

nodalmerge.buildCommand.description: Global build command (empty = auto-detect per branch).

nodalmerge.testCommand.description: Global test command (empty = auto-detect per branch).

nodalmerge.postMergeExecutionMode.description: Post-merge execution mode: Disabled (no execution), Async (background fire-and-forget), Blocking (synchronous with rollback on failure).
